items.name: Ring Zero Hearth
items.depicts: A red-walled kernel furnace with glowing yellow and coral bars inside, topped by a large silver gear, a smaller copper gear, and a grey smokestack.

items.name: Syscall Table
items.depicts: A dark grey-framed dispatch board holding a four-by-eight grid of cyan-indexed blue and grey slots with one active yellow entry.

items.name: Cycle Cogs
items.depicts: A meshing pair of silver and copper toothed gears turning against each other.

items.name: Dmesg Marquee
items.depicts: A wide dark console bezel scrolling bright green kernel log fragments such as FUTEX and EXT4-FS above a green status lamp.

items.name: PSI Barometer
items.depicts: A horizontal red bar clamped by two dark grey brackets with a detached vertical red needle hovering above a central notch.

items.name: Preempt Plunger
items.depicts: A narrow vertical dark grey cylinder hovering above a flat light grey rail.

items.name: Taint Indicators
items.depicts: A small grey-bezelled black panel housing a two-by-three bank of square green lamps and one red lamp.

items.name: Round-Robin Wheel
items.depicts: A spoked grey wheel mounted on a dark base with six colour-coded task squares riding around its rim.

items.name: Four-Level Folio
items.depicts: A grey four-drawer vertical cabinet whose dark slots each hold a silver bar, three of them marked with a lit green square.

items.name: Interrupt Bell
items.depicts: A bright yellow bell suspended from a dark grey bracket with a brown clapper hanging below.

items.name: Kernel Turnstile
items.depicts: A dark grey pedestal mounted with rotating silver barrier arms.

items.name: Bonwick Tray
items.depicts: Four grey vertical compartments beneath a copper header bar, three stacked with paired green or cyan fixed-width bars and one empty.

items.name: Jiffy Spitter
items.depicts: A small grey box on the left emitting a horizontal trail of red and grey rectangular dashes to the right.

items.name: Call-Gate Portcullis
items.depicts: A heavy dark grey archway fitted with a lowered silver portcullis grate.

items.name: Run Queue
items.depicts: A horizontal two-tone grey track carrying cyan, yellow, green, and narrow red task blocks lined up in order.

items.name: Sleeping Padlock
items.depicts: A brown brass padlock with yellow top trim, a silver shackle, a dark keyhole, and a small yellow key extending from its right side.

items.name: Storm Gauge
items.depicts: A square dark grey-framed screen showing four vertical bars, three cyan and one tall yellow column, above a silver baseline.

items.name: Shootdown Board
items.depicts: A grey-framed black panel holding a four-by-three grid of teal and navy cache slots with one bright white hit.

items.name: Vruntime Meter
items.depicts: A small grey-framed black panel displaying three horizontal progress bars, one green and two cyan, across dark blue tracks.

items.name: Dijkstra Signal
items.depicts: A narrow vertical dark grey signal housing on a post with three square lenses, the top red lens lit and the lower two dark.

items.name: Ring Buffer
items.depicts: An open circle of ten small square slots, seven dark grey and three sequentially lit bright cyan.

items.name: Deadman Countdown
items.depicts: A grey-framed black console with a green indicator on the top left, a dark indicator on the top right, and a yellow-and-grey countdown bar below.

items.name: VFS Junction
items.depicts: A round silver junction hub with a red-and-charcoal core connected to four coloured conduits in green, cyan, magenta, and yellow.

items.name: Futex Box
items.depicts: A yellow-bordered black box enclosing two large square state cells, bright green on the left and coral red on the right.

items.name: Edge-Trigger Slate
items.depicts: A cyan-framed black panel containing four vertical descriptor bars, three dark grey and one lit bright green.

items.name: Quota Terrarium
items.depicts: A grey-framed white enclosure subdivided into three nested coloured boxes: cyan-blue at top left, green at top right, and a wide red partition below.

items.name: Bottom-Half Belt
items.depicts: A dark grey horizontal rail carrying four alternating cyan and yellow square work items.

items.name: Buddy Allocator
items.depicts: Three grey-bordered vertical strips showing power-of-two memory subdivision: a wide blue block, a half-width green block, and two stacked brown and red quarter-blocks.

items.name: Kworker Drone
items.depicts: A compact silver-grey boxy automaton in a black U-frame with two stubby feet, a glowing cyan, green, or yellow visor, and a tipped top antenna.
